integrity: A full mathematical argument and finite reproducibility checks are included. This work is not independently validated; the 1999 primary article was not available in full.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple loopless digraphs and their signed graph symmetries; no homeomorphism or non-acyclic graph-property claim. Older published equivalent formulations not ruled out with certainty.
title: Signed equivariant sphere models for acyclic directed-subgraph complexes
